content.description: Iteration 2: all it01 specs had queues 4x too long (M5/length 47-58 m vs 13 m) and discharge headways 1.5-3x too slow (M1), so this spec shortens tau/minGap and raises accel for cars and motorcycles, adds a dedicated red-running motorcycle archetype with wider early-start and swarm coverage, cuts the right-lane share of seekers (M9a/M9b too high), and lengthens the box release hold.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car (sim 0.84-0.96 s vs 0.39 s) and M5/length (sim 47-58 m vs 13 m): discharge headway is roughly tau plus the vehicle length plus minGap over speed, so tau 0.55, minGap 1.0 (range lower end), accel 4 and sigma 0.2 shorten it and the queue; impatience 0 with no jmDriveAfterRedTime keeps M3/share/car near 0.003.

Targets M1/car and M8/car (0.056): a small minority with the lowest practical tau and lcAssertive 2 accepts tighter gaps, pulling the mean car discharge headway down toward 0.39 s and giving the riskier lane changes behind wrong-lane turns; no red-running attributes so M3/share/car is not raised.

Targets M1/moto (sim 0.52-0.63 s vs 0.30 s), M5/length and M5/moto_density (sim 0.074-0.081 vs 0.045 veh/m2): the lowest tau, minGap 0.5, accel 6 and sigma 0.1 let motorcycles discharge faster so the queue clears and is shorter; moderate impatience with jmDriveAfterRedTime 4 and jmDriveRedSpeed 6 lifts M3/share/moto (sim 0.02 vs 0.09) without changing the lateral parameters that already gave lat_moto close to 7.1 m.

Targets M3/share/moto (sim 0.02 vs 0.09), M3/per_cycle (sim 0.4-1.0 vs 4.4) and M2/early/moto (sim 0.005 vs 0.13): impatience 1 with jmDriveAfterRedTime 8 s and jmDriveRedSpeed 8 m/s lets this 15 percent group enter the junction on red, which is the only way to reach 4 violations per cycle; lcAssertive 2 and low minGapLat support filtering to the front row.

Targets M6/approach/s/moto and l/moto (27-29 s observed): the share is cut from 0.10-0.15 to 0.08 because all it01 specs overshoot approach time by 2-6x, so slow riders must stay a minority; speedFactor 0.8 keeps a visible slow group for the slow_lane_center behaviour without adding to M5/length.

Targets M10a/per_cycle (0.27 observed; it01 s00 with 10 percent seekers gave 0.21) and M9a/per_cycle (0.33 observed, it01 sim 0.9-4.6): the seeker share returns to 0.12 to keep the sidewalk count, while the right-lane probability in the rule is cut sharply; tau 0.4, minGap 0.5 and accel 6 match the faster discharge of the other riders to help M1/moto.

Targets M7a/n_waiting (sim 1.6-3.9 vs 5.5) and M7b/clear_lag (sim 6.0 vs 6.65 in the closest it01 spec): the it01 s03 values (jmTimegapMinor 1.0, impatience 0.5) gave clear_lag within one observed-day distance, so they are kept; minGap lowered to 0.5 lets more riders fit in the box.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M2/early/moto (sim 0.004-0.007 vs 0.13) and M2/first_delay (sim 2.3-4.6 vs 2.1 s): in it01 most attempts ended with red_ended_before_crossing (57 of 89 not executed), so the window goes to the 10 s maximum and v_max to 5 m/s so that riders cover the stop line before the red ends, and p 0.5 raises the front-row share toward 0.13; cars are excluded (M2/early/car already 0.003-0.01 vs 0.001).

Targets M3/share/moto (sim 0.009-0.022 vs 0.092) and M3/per_cycle (sim 0.4-1.0 vs 4.4) while keeping M3/var_to_mean near 1.3 (it01 s03 gave 1.38 with k 0.05): p0 rises from 0.04-0.06 to 0.2 and the rule is applied to all fast motorcycle archetypes, with k 0.1 for follower clustering; cars excluded because M3/share/car is 0.003.

Targets M9a/per_cycle (0.33 observed vs 0.9-4.6 simulated), M9b/share_blocked (0.021 observed vs 0.15-0.30) and M10a/per_cycle (0.27 observed): p_right_lane drops from 0.03-0.1 to 0.015 because right-lane draws were 158-800 per run set and blocked right turners, while p_sidewalk 0.08 follows s00 (0.06 gave 0.21/cycle); p_wrong_lane stays 0.2 at the observed F2 level (q0-40 m) though it is redistributed on this net; the 12 m trigger matches the observed 13 m choice queue.

Targets M7a/release_time (sim 0.36 vs 2.59 s in the closest it01 spec) and M7c/slope (sim 0.05 vs 0.33 s/veh): raising the extra hold from 1 s to 2 s delays box exit after the opposing green end by about 1 s, which moves release_time upward and increases the start delay of the crossing road per waiter without changing safety checks; M7b/clear_lag (6.0 vs 6.65) should move slightly closer.

Targets M6/approach moto times and M4/lat_moto (sim 7.0-7.1 vs 7.085 m, already close): unchanged from it01 because lat_moto is near the target; lateral offset 0 keeps slow riders in the lane centre as in the specs with the best M4/lat_moto.

reasoning: All it01 specs had queues 4x too long and discharge headway 2x too slow, with 0 early-start/red-run success and too many right-lane choices; this spec speeds up car/moto discharge parameters, widens early start and swarm red running to all fast moto classes, lowers p_right_lane, and increases the box release lag.
